context: M14 o2. Kallis Fur Salon. White suit, panama hat on the desk. He pays in an envelope already sealed.

lines.speaker: char.stavros_kallis
lines.text: Ah, the new collector. In a hot summer every furrier becomes a philosopher.

lines.speaker: char.stavros_kallis
lines.text: Tell your sergeant Kallis pays early. Unlike some on Thirtieth Street.

lines.speaker: char.stavros_kallis
lines.text: Varelas. A great man. Ask his bank how great. Good afternoon.
